items.title: George Williams Interview, 1959-03-17
items.q: So, Morgan, Sam Morgan's come by every night... after a while, Morgan needed a drummer... That told me to go with Chris Kelly... I worked with Chris Kelly for many years... Well I played with Chris Kelly for about three years... went with Joyce McCoy, went with Joyce McCullen.

ctx.x: Is the district still running then? The district was still running then. And we played there for years. I played there for about a year, maybe two years. As long as I was running, I went to the entertainers. You heard of the entertainers? Well I still played there a while. So from then on, Sam Morgan had a drummer by the name of Roy Evans. Well, Roy Evans got hit with a brick, appetite on a truck. And it seemed like the drummer that Morgan had, the drummer that was playing with Morgan got hit with a brick. Yeah.…
If you have to answer the phone, it's alright too. If we can stop it at any time or any time you want to stop. If you want to turn out. Tell her that you can answer. We can stop if you want to turn.
